label: GDPR Article 33 personal data breach notification
statusNote: Data subjects (Article 34) are told without undue delay when the risk is high; there is no fixed number of hours, so that notice has no clock here.

triggers.label: Controller became aware of a personal data breach

clocks.label: Notification to the supervisory authority
clocks.rule: Without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after becoming aware. A late notification gives the reasons for the delay.

appliesTo.note: Controllers processing personal data of people in the EU.
